notes.title: A patch is released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39638986/911808e76a0dcfd1b07c3602c8605683a52df683.jpg[/img]

Hello, tanukis!

We are happy to announce the game has just received a patch.

[b]The following issues have been fixed:[/b]
1) a debug mode in stage 6,
2) an invisible enemy in the second part of the stage 4

Hope you like the fixes.

Cheers!

tags.bug: 2) an invisible enemy in the second part of the stage 4
